t: Bid and Ask - Definition, Example, How it Works in Trading
s: July 8, 2024 - Bid and ask is a very important concept that many retail investors overlook when transacting. It is important to note that the current stock price is the price of the last trade – a historical price. On the other hand, the bid and ask are the prices that buyers and sellers are willing to trade at.
